# Player world navigation and library request ownership

Date: 2026-09-13. Status: accepted for the isolated player-workflow implementation.

The existing PI Desktop chooser is extended with native world lists and bundled starter metadata. No parallel world database, front-end shell or model gateway is introduced. Template import is normal world creation with immutable shipped source and authored initial state. Runtime/component identities remain governed by native world scope and normal materialization.

Library actions stage exact asset-version references in the normal Composer. The staged request belongs to a world and optional session; it is consumed only by that matching creation context. Appending preserves the live draft and files. Source proposals remain player-owned installation actions routed through the existing package service and native permission checks. Checks, candidate preview, adoption and progress saving remain separate receipts.

This extends the player entry and conversation ownership rules to arbitrary stored worlds and examples while preserving the approved client shell.
